---
title: "Example reports"
---

```{r, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE)
runs <- tryCatch(jsonlite::fromJSON("../../pkgdown/assets/example-reports.json"), error = function(e) NULL)
if (is.null(runs)) runs <- tryCatch(jsonlite::fromJSON("../example-reports.json"), error = function(e) NULL)
fmt <- function(x) format(x, big.mark = ",", scientific = FALSE, trim = TRUE)
```

Two reports from `render_report()`, both run against the
[Fake NHS Trust synthetic dataset](https://github.com/ThomUK/synthetic-hospital-data)
read through its `fakehospdata` package. The **sampled** report profiles
large tables on a sample of their rows, which is how a big warehouse is
usually run. The **full** report profiles every row of every table, so its
distinct counts and uniqueness are exact. They are regenerated by the
`example-reports` workflow on the repository's Actions tab, run by hand.

```{r runs, results = "asis"}
if (is.null(runs) || nrow(runs) == 0) {
  cat("The reports have not been generated yet. Run the `example-reports` workflow from the Actions tab.\n")
} else {
  tab <- data.frame(
    Report = runs$label,
    Dataset = paste0(runs$scale, " set"),
    `Sampling threshold` = ifelse(is.infinite(runs$sample_rows), "none", paste(fmt(runs$sample_rows), "rows")),
    Tables = runs$tables, `Tables sampled` = runs$tables_sampled, Columns = runs$columns,
    `Rows in total` = fmt(runs$rows), `FK candidates` = runs$fk_candidates,
    `Run time` = ifelse(runs$seconds >= 60, sprintf("%.0f min", runs$seconds / 60), paste(runs$seconds, "s")),
    Rendered = runs$rendered_at, check.names = FALSE
  )
  print(knitr::kable(tab))
}
```

```{r frames, results = "asis"}
if (!is.null(runs) && nrow(runs) > 0) {
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(runs))) {
    cat(sprintf("\n## %s report\n\n", tools::toTitleCase(runs$label[i])))
    cat(sprintf('<p><a href="../%s" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Open in its own window</a> (%.1f MB)</p>\n\n', runs$file[i], runs$size_mb[i]))
    cat(sprintf('<iframe src="../%s" title="%s example report" style="width: 100%%; height: 85vh; border: 1px solid #dee2e6; border-radius: 4px;" loading="lazy"></iframe>\n\n', runs$file[i], runs$label[i]))
  }
}
```

To make one for your own database:

```r
library(DBinventory)
inventory_run("Driver={ODBC Driver 18 for SQL Server};Server=...;Database=...;Trusted_Connection=yes;",
              organisation = "Your NHS Trust", store = "dw_inventory.sqlite", report = "dw_inventory.html")
```
